column5: [why the floor went down]: ship trust run --update-ratchet raises floors; a floor goes down only with a reason

astream b16c766 (realign/astream-primitives) moved astream-cap's const HMAC core to astream-digest, whose row holds it now (413/416 -> 746/762): the pad expansions, the digest-key pad and the parts loop left with their code, astream-aead's copy became the same one, and capfile gained its one-open secret-file readers (627/697 -> 302/384); measured by ship trust run -p astream-cap -p astream-digest on this branch, same prover, and astream's own verify-ready agrees (cap 302, digest 746 on e467a1d)

re-based onto store build 15698 (20565c325), this host's prover since 2026-10-21 04:27 UTC, a count change, no lost proof (per-obligation diff of both provers on one tree, 2026-10-21): on the realigned source (astream b16c766 moved astream-cap's const HMAC core here), 321aaeda7 at its 16 GiB ceiling reproduces 746/762 (hand measurement, peak 4.8 GiB) and 20565c325 proves 711/732; the proved rows moved only in five functions whose every obligation is proved under both provers, 20565c325 emitting fewer: encode_state_be 88/88 -> 64/64, write_pad_len_be 37/37 -> 30/30, load_be_u32 17/17 -> 14/14, sha256_sigma0_small and sha256_sigma1_small 3/3 -> 2/2, and ct_eq proves one more (4/6 -> 5/6); no function proves less; measured by ship trust run -p astream-digest on main 32e374ba83 merged (docs/measured/trust-floors-36gib-2026-10-20.md)

re-based onto trust 0.11.0 (20565c325, the published store prover, no verifier ceiling), 2026-10-20: it counts about 100000 obligations the seal did not (unsupported_mir, mostly the fail-closed UnmodeledThreadSpawnEffect) and proves 854/113510 on the floor's own tree 3f75801d67, where the seal proved 4720/26328 at a 16 GiB ceiling (m29); 755 here against 854 there is not the code's: 141 lost proofs are in files neither tree changed, and proofs the solver found but no lane minted authority for grew 4076 -> 4662. Measured by ship trust run -p aterm-agent --prover <store trust 15698>/bin --try-refused on ki2/trust merged with a5e2d03163 (docs/measured/trust-ceiling-2026-10-20.md)

aterm-adopt (realign) moved aterm-digest's HMAC-SHA256 (src/hmac_sha256.rs) and ct_eq to astream-digest, whose row holds that code now (746/762 since b16c766), and the crate re-exports them: what is left is the two envelope-header codecs, all of it proved (196/207 -> 172/172); measured by ship trust run -p aterm-digest --prover <store trust 9192>/bin (321aaeda7, the row's own prover) on realign/aterm-adopt, exit 1 only as RATCHET-REGRESSION(<196) against the old row

re-based onto trust 0.11.0 (20565c325, the published store prover): it proves 103/161 on the floor's own tree 62b4b84621, where the seal 321aaeda7 proved 131/162, and the same 103 here (103/163; by kind hardened_panic_boundary 45, index_out_of_bounds 17, shift_overflow_shl 14, shift_overflow_shr 14, unreachable 13 on both trees), so the fall is the prover's; the 2 added obligations are unsupported_mir unknowns. Measured by targo trust check -p aterm-durable --lib --allow-l0-gaps under <store trust 15698> on both trees, and judged by ship trust run -p aterm-durable

re-based onto 0.11.0, a count change, no lost proof (per-obligation diff of both provers on one tree, 2026-10-21): Trust 919716f6d89 (SELF-GUARDED-LITERAL-OPERAND-2) merged the generic overflow row that repeated each literal shift's shift row, so 26 such rows in encode_log_header_le/decode_log_header_le, all proved under 321aaeda7 (121/166), are gone while their shift and panic-boundary rows stay proved; no proved row changed status; should_rotate's Certified postcondition is new (+1); the total grew with spawn-census and conditional rows that carry no proof credit

the CRC-32 tables left with their code, 2026-10-20: checksum.rs's Crc32 wraps astream-wire's crc32_ieee_update (whose own row holds the compile-time slicing tables) and keeps the wrapper and Adler-32; tables() and its closure took 31 proofs and 44 obligations, Crc32::update 54 and 83, and of, write_chunk and read_chunk shed 3 unknowns (306/780 -> 221/650), measured per function by ship trust run -p aterm-codec -p aterm-png -p aterm-hash on 91827f5c92 and on this branch

194/586 was measured at 74b8b6553a, whose budgeted search no longer verifies the eviction-schedule window (the proved index::final_evicted_prefix left with it) and whose derived Clone impls (SearchIndex, TerminalSearch) call HashMap::clone, an absent callee; the StreamingSearch engine (33a37947e2) and the dead bitmap, bytesearch and grapheme paths deleted since (merged at c37fe9a204) took 66 obligations out and the tree proves 23 fewer: re-measured 2026-10-20 on the merged tree, same prover, 8 GiB host at its 1.0 GiB ceiling (the floor's own)

DecodeError gained the NoChecksum unit variant (ZC.5), and the derived PartialEq no longer emits the unreachable arm at error.rs:12 that proved: the obligation left the code (720 -> 719); every per-function count of unproved obligations is as before

The 635 was measured on the 2026-10-17 merged tree the gates branch landed from; the code that landed on main since moved 78 obligations out and 19 fewer prove (re-measured on the final merged tree, same prover): the floor follows the measurement, not the branch
